This document reproduces all tables and figures of the paper from the Parquet files written in Step 3 of the README (`results/parquet_v2/`, `results/original_predictions_v2/`, `results/hyperparameters_v2/` and `results/evaluation_v2/`). The code is taken directly from the manuscript source. Render it from the repository root:

```bash
quarto render results/scripts/figures_and_tables.qmd
```

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup-theme

library(ggplot2)

# Use one visual style and palette throughout the manuscript.
dark2_palette <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")

options(
  ggplot2.discrete.colour = dark2_palette,
  ggplot2.discrete.fill = dark2_palette
)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = grey(0.95), color = NA)
    )
)

fmt_percent <- function(x, accuracy = 0.1) {
  scales::percent(x, accuracy = accuracy)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-data

library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(pROC)

evaluation_results <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "evaluation_v2")
) |>
  collect()

original_predictions <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "original_predictions_v2")
) |>
  collect()

evaluation_manifest <- read_parquet(
  here::here("results", "evaluation_v2_manifest.parquet")
)

# Keep the larger sample size first, as in the version 1 figures.
sample_sizes <- c(458L, 229L)
sample_size_labels <- paste0("N = ", sample_sizes)

model_levels <- c("Elastic Net", "Random Forest")

method_labels <- c(
  bootstrap = "Non-param. boot",
  bootstrap_par = "Parametric boot",
  bootstrap_635 = "Out-of-bag boot",
  cross_validation_10 = "10-fold CV",
  cross_validation_5 = "5-fold CV",
  cross_validation_2 = "2-fold CV",
  independent = "Independent"
)

metric_labels <- c(
  variance = "variance",
  pi_width = "95% range width",
  MAPE = "MAPE",
  tMAPE = "tMAPE",
  q025 = "2.5th %",
  q975 = "97.5th %"
)

evaluation_results <- evaluation_results |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    ),
    model_label = factor(
      model,
      levels = c("glmnet", "random_forest"),
      labels = model_levels
    ),
    method_label = factor(
      method,
      levels = names(method_labels),
      labels = unname(method_labels)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(sample_size_label, method, model, id, iter)

original_predictions <- original_predictions |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    ),
    model_label = factor(
      model,
      levels = c("glmnet", "random_forest"),
      labels = model_levels
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(sample_size_label, model, iter, id)


auc_by_iteration <- original_predictions |>
  summarise(
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(y, original_pred_p, quiet = TRUE)),
    .by = c(sample_size, sample_size_label, model, model_label, dgm, iter)
  )

auc_summary <- auc_by_iteration |>
  summarise(
    mean_AUC = mean(AUC),
    lower = quantile(AUC, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(AUC, 0.975),
    .by = c(sample_size, sample_size_label, model, model_label, dgm)
  )

primary_metrics <- c("variance", "pi_width", "MAPE", "tMAPE")
comparison_metrics <- c(primary_metrics, "q025", "q975")
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-independent-auc
#| cache: true

# AUCs of models fitted to independently sampled data and applied to the
# corresponding original dataset.
oob_auc_indep <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "parquet_v2")
) |>
  filter(method == "independent") |>
  select(sample_size, dgm, model, iter, re_sample, y, pred_p) |>
  collect() |>
  summarise(
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(y, pred_p, quiet = TRUE)),
    .by = c(sample_size, dgm, model, iter, re_sample)
  )

# Boxplot summaries of AUCs pooled across iterations.
oob_auc_indep_summary <- oob_auc_indep |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    )
  ) |>
  summarise(
    lower_whisker = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[1],
    lower_hinge = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[2],
    median_AUC = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[3],
    upper_hinge = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[4],
    upper_whisker = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[5],
    mean_AUC = mean(AUC),
    lower = quantile(AUC, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(AUC, 0.975),
    .by = c(sample_size, sample_size_label, model, dgm)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-comparisons

# Reshape the reference and practical-procedure results to one metric per row.
reference_results <- evaluation_results |>
  filter(method == "independent") |>
  select(
    sample_size,
    sample_size_label,
    model,
    model_label,
    dgm,
    iter,
    id,
    all_of(comparison_metrics)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    all_of(comparison_metrics),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "reference"
  )

comparison_results <- evaluation_results |>
  filter(method != "independent") |>
  select(
    sample_size,
    sample_size_label,
    model,
    model_label,
    method,
    method_label,
    dgm,
    iter,
    id,
    true_p,
    original_pred_p,
    all_of(comparison_metrics)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    all_of(comparison_metrics),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    reference_results,
    by = c(
      "sample_size",
      "sample_size_label",
      "model",
      "model_label",
      "dgm",
      "iter",
      "id",
      "metric"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference = estimate - reference,
    absolute_difference = abs(difference),
    rel_abs_difference = absolute_difference / reference,
    metric_label = factor(
      metric,
      levels = names(metric_labels),
      labels = unname(metric_labels)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-event-fractions
completeness <- evaluation_manifest |>
  select(iterations, min_resamples) |>
  unique()

event_smry <- original_predictions |>
  distinct(sample_size, dgm, iter, id, y) |>
  summarise(event_fraction = mean(y), .by = c(sample_size, dgm, iter)) |>
  summarise(
    mean_ef = mean(event_fraction),
    min = min(event_fraction),
    max = max(event_fraction),
    lower = quantile(event_fraction, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(event_fraction, 0.975),
    .by = c(sample_size, dgm)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-reference-summary
reference_by_iteration <- evaluation_results |>
  filter(method == "independent") |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(primary_metrics), mean),
    .by = c(sample_size_label, model_label, dgm, iter)
  )

reference_summary <- reference_by_iteration |>
  pivot_longer(
    all_of(primary_metrics),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    lower = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .by = c(sample_size_label, model_label, dgm, metric)
  )

# Extract selected reference values for inline reporting.
get_reference_mean <- function(
  sample_size_value,
  model_name,
  metric_name,
  dgm_name
) {
  reference_summary |>
    filter(
      sample_size_label == paste0("N = ", sample_size_value),
      model_label == model_name,
      metric == metric_name,
      dgm == dgm_name
    ) |>
    pull(mean)
}

# Express contrasts on a relative scale.
relative_change <- function(new_value, reference_value) {
  new_value / reference_value - 1
}
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-agreement-plot-function

plot_agreement <- function(metric_name, dgm_name = "linear") {
  plot_data <- comparison_results |>
    filter(
      metric == metric_name,
      dgm == dgm_name
    )

  plot_limits <- range(
    c(plot_data$reference, plot_data$estimate),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(reference, estimate)) +
    geom_bin_2d(bins = 100) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = grey(0.5), linewidth = 0.25) +
    # facet_grid(
    #   rows = vars(method_label),
    #   cols = vars(model_label, sample_size_label)
    # ) +
    ggh4x::facet_nested(
      rows = vars(method_label),
      cols = vars(model_label, sample_size_label),
      nest_line = element_line(color = "white", linewidth = 1),
      strip = ggh4x::strip_nested(
        text_x = list(
          element_text(margin = margin(b = 5, t = 3)), # model labels
          element_text(margin = margin(b = 3, t = 5)) # sample-size labels
        ),
        by_layer_x = TRUE
      )
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = plot_limits, ylim = plot_limits) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
    labs(
      x = "Independent sampling",
      y = "Resampling procedure",
      fill = "Count"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

# Main text

## Tables 1 and 2

**Table 1. Overview of simulation scenarios.**

```{r}
#| label: table-1

simulation_settings <- data.frame(
  Factor = c(
    "Data-Generating Mechanism",
    "Sample Size",
    "Target Outcome Fraction\\textsuperscript{*}",
    "Number of Predictor Parameters"
  ),
  S1 = c("Linear", "458", "0.25", "12"),
  S2 = c("Linear", "229", "0.25", "12"),
  S3 = c("Non-linear", "458", "0.275", "12"),
  S4 = c("Non-linear", "229", "0.275", "12"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

kableExtra::kbl(
  simulation_settings,
  format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
  col.names = c("", paste("Scenario", 1:4)),
  escape = FALSE
) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = "HOLD_position",
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  kableExtra::footnote(
    symbol = paste(
      "For the non-linear DGM, the outcome fraction refers",
      "to the logistic model used to generate the Random Forest's initial training data."
    ),
    symbol_title = "",
    escape = FALSE,
    threeparttable = TRUE,
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )
```

**Table 2. Overview of methods for estimating stability of individual predictions.**

```{r}
#| label: table-2

resampling_methods <- data.frame(
  Method = c(
    "Independent sampling",
    "Non-parametric bootstrap",
    "Parametric bootstrap",
    "Out-of-bag bootstrap",
    "10-fold cross-validation",
    "5-fold cross-validation",
    "2-fold cross-validation"
  ),
  Description = c(
    "Generate 200 independent datasets of size $N$ from the true data-generating mechanism. Fit models to each and predict for individuals in the initial dataset. This serves as the baseline for ideal stability estimation.",
    "Draw 200 bootstrap samples of size $N$ with replacement from the initial dataset. Fit models to each resample and predict for all individuals in the initial dataset.",
    "Fit each model-development procedure to the initial dataset and obtain model-specific fitted probabilities. For each of 200 replicates, simulate a separate Bernoulli outcome vector from each model's fitted probabilities while keeping the predictor matrix fixed. Refit each model to its own simulated outcomes and predict all individuals in the initial dataset.",
    "Draw bootstrap samples of size $N$ with replacement, fit both models, and predict only for the individuals absent from each sample. Continue until each individual has 200 out-of-bag predictions.",
    "Repeat 10-fold cross-validation 200 times. In each repetition, fit 10 models, each using nine folds to predict the remaining fold, so each individual receives one prediction from a model fitted to approximately $0.9N$ observations in each of the 200 repetitions.",
    "Analogous to repeated 10-fold cross-validation, using approximately $0.8N$ observations for each fit.",
    "Analogous to repeated 10-fold cross-validation, using approximately $0.5N$ observations for each fit."
  )
)

kableExtra::kbl(
  resampling_methods,
  format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = knitr::is_latex_output(),
  align = c("l", "l"),
  escape = FALSE,
  linesep = "\\addlinespace"
) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = "repeat_header",
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "4.2cm") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(2, width = "10.0cm")
```

## Table 3

**Table 3. Prediction instability under independent sampling.**

```{r}
#| label: table-3

reference_table <- reference_summary |>
  mutate(
    value = if_else(
      metric == "variance",
      sprintf("%.4f [%.4f, %.4f]", mean, lower, upper),
      sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", mean, lower, upper)
    ),
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = primary_metrics,
      labels = unname(metric_labels[primary_metrics])
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    `Sample size` = sample_size_label,
    Model = model_label,
    DGM = dgm,
    metric,
    value
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Sample size`, values_from = value)

reference_table |>
  select(-Model) |>
  kbl(
    format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = "lcc"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "hold_position",
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  collapse_rows(column = 1, latex_hline = "none") |>
  # Use lighter separators within each DGM and grey between DGMs.
  row_spec(
    c(1:3, 5:7, 9:11, 13:15),
    extra_latex_after = "\\arrayrulecolor{lightgray}\\cmidrule{2-4}\\arrayrulecolor{black}",
    extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid lightgrey;"
  ) |>
  row_spec(
    c(4, 12),
    extra_latex_after = "\\arrayrulecolor{gray}\\cmidrule{1-4}\\arrayrulecolor{black}",
    extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid grey;"
  ) |>
  row_spec(8, extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule{1-4}") |>
  group_rows("Elastic Net", 1, 8) |>
  group_rows("Random Forest", 9, 16)
```

## Figure 1

**Figure 1. Individual-level prediction instability under independent sampling across the true (DGM) outcome probability range.**

```{r}
#| label: figure-1
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8.8
#| cache: true

instability_risk_plot <- subset(evaluation_results, method == "independent") |>
  pivot_longer(
    all_of(primary_metrics),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric_label = factor(
      metric,
      levels = primary_metrics,
      labels = unname(metric_labels[primary_metrics])
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = true_p,
    y = value,
    color = model_label,
    linetype = sample_size_label,
    fill = model_label
  )) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs")) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(metric_label),
    cols = vars(dgm),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Value",
    color = "Model",
    fill = "Model",
    linetype = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  guides(
    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black"))
  )

# Count each simulated individual once, independently of the fitted model.
risk_distribution_data <- original_predictions |>
  filter(model == "glmnet", sample_size == 458)

risk_distribution_plot <- ggplot(risk_distribution_data, aes(true_p)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.025,
    boundary = 0,
    fill = "grey60",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(dgm)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(x = "True (DGM) outcome probability", y = "Count") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

cowplot::plot_grid(
  instability_risk_plot,
  risk_distribution_plot,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  axis = "lr",
  rel_heights = c(6, 1)
)
```

## Figures 4 and 5

**Figure 4. Absolute relative deviation from independent sampling across the true (DGM) outcome probability range, linear DGM, larger sample size.**

```{r}
#| label: figure-4
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.8
#| cache: true

comparison_results |>
  filter(
    dgm == "linear",
    metric %in% primary_metrics,
    sample_size_label == sample_size_labels[1]
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(true_p, rel_abs_difference, color = method_label, fill = method_label)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = grey(0.5), linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "gam",
    formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs")
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(metric_label),
    cols = vars(model_label),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme(panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "True (DGM) outcome probability",
    y = "Absolute relative deviation",
    color = "Procedure",
    fill = "Procedure"
  )
```

## Figures 6 and 7

**Figure 6. Prediction instability plot for selected procedures, linear DGM, one initial dataset of the smaller sample size.**

```{r}
#| label: figure-6
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7

example_method_ids <- c(
  "independent",
  "bootstrap",
  "bootstrap_635",
  "cross_validation_2"
)

example_prediction_results <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "parquet_v2")
) |>
  filter(dgm == "linear") |>
  filter(
    sample_size == 229,
    method %in% example_method_ids,
    iter == 60
  ) |>
  collect()

example_prediction_results |>
  left_join(
    select(
      original_predictions,
      id,
      iter,
      sample_size,
      dgm,
      model,
      model_label,
      original_pred_p
    ),
    by = c("dgm", "sample_size", "model", "iter", "id")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    method_label = factor(
      method,
      levels = example_method_ids,
      labels = unname(method_labels[example_method_ids])
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = original_pred_p, y = pred_p)) +
  ggrastr::rasterise(
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.2),
    dpi = 300,
    dev = "ragg"
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(model_label), cols = vars(method_label)) +
  labs(
    x = "Original estimated outcome probability",
    y = "Estimated outcome probability under resampling procedure"
  )
```

# Supplementary material

## S-Table 1

**S-Table 1. Model performance in the original datasets.**

```{r}
#| label: s-table-1

initial_performance_table <- auc_summary |>
  left_join(
    select(
      oob_auc_indep_summary,
      sample_size,
      dgm,
      model,
      independent_mean_AUC = mean_AUC,
      independent_lower = lower,
      independent_upper = upper
    ),
    by = c("sample_size", "dgm", "model")
  ) |>
  left_join(event_smry, by = c("sample_size", "dgm")) |>
  arrange(desc(sample_size), dgm, model) |>
  transmute(
    `Sample\nsize` = sample_size_label,
    DGM = dgm,
    `Outcome fraction` = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      mean_ef,
      lower.y,
      upper.y
    ),
    Model = model_label,
    `AUC\nin-sample` = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      mean_AUC,
      lower.x,
      upper.x
    ),
    `AUC\nindependent-sample` = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      independent_mean_AUC,
      independent_lower,
      independent_upper
    )
  )

initial_performance_table %>%
  kbl(
    format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
    col.names = kableExtra::linebreak(colnames(.), align = "c"),
    booktabs = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    align = "lllccc"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "hold_position",
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  collapse_rows(columns = c(1:3), valign = "middle", latex_hline = "none") |>
  # Use light grey between models and grey between DGMs.
  row_spec(
    c(1, 3, 5, 7),
    extra_latex_after = "\\arrayrulecolor{lightgray}\\cmidrule{4-6}\\arrayrulecolor{black}",
    extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid lightgrey;"
  ) |>
  row_spec(
    c(2, 6),
    extra_latex_after = "\\arrayrulecolor{gray}\\cmidrule{2-6}\\arrayrulecolor{black}",
    extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid grey;"
  ) |>
  row_spec(4, extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule{1-6}")
```

## S-Figure 1

**S-Figure 1. AUCs of models fitted to independently sampled development data and applied to the initial datasets.**

```{r}
#| label: s-figure-1
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8.7

oob_auc_indep |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = iter, y = AUC, group = iter)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = oob_auc_indep_summary,
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = lower_whisker,
      ymax = upper_whisker
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey40",
    alpha = 0.08
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = oob_auc_indep_summary,
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = lower_hinge,
      ymax = upper_hinge
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey40",
    alpha = 0.20
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(size = 0.35, width = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(
    data = oob_auc_indep_summary,
    aes(yintercept = median_AUC),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    sample_size_label + dgm ~ model,
```

## S-Figures 26 to 29

**S-Figure 26. Hyperparameters selected for the original Elastic Net fits, linear DGM.**

```{r}
#| label: s-figure-26
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

library(patchwork)

glmnet_hyperparameters <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "hyperparameters_v2"),
  unify_schemas = TRUE
) |>
  filter(dgm == "linear", model == "glmnet") |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(desc(sample_size), iter) |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    )
  )

glmnet_scatter <- ggplot(
  glmnet_hyperparameters,
  aes(x = alpha, y = lambda, color = sample_size_label)
) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, width = 0.015, height = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(x = "Alpha", y = "Lambda", color = "Sample size")

glmnet_alpha_histogram <- ggplot(
  glmnet_hyperparameters,
  aes(alpha, fill = sample_size_label)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 50,
    boundary = -0.05,
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

glmnet_lambda_histogram <- ggplot(
  glmnet_hyperparameters,
  aes(lambda, fill = sample_size_label)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

(glmnet_alpha_histogram + plot_spacer()) /
  (glmnet_scatter + glmnet_lambda_histogram) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1), heights = c(1, 4))
```

```{r}
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    )
  )

glmnet_scatter_nonlin <- ggplot(
  glmnet_hyperparameters_nonlin,
  aes(x = alpha, y = lambda, color = sample_size_label)
) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, width = 0.015, height = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(x = "Alpha", y = "Lambda", color = "Sample size")

glmnet_alpha_histogram_nonlin <- ggplot(
  glmnet_hyperparameters_nonlin,
  aes(alpha, fill = sample_size_label)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 50,
    boundary = -0.05,
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

glmnet_lambda_histogram_nonlin <- ggplot(
  glmnet_hyperparameters_nonlin,
  aes(lambda, fill = sample_size_label)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

(glmnet_alpha_histogram_nonlin + plot_spacer()) /
  (glmnet_scatter_nonlin + glmnet_lambda_histogram_nonlin) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1), heights = c(1, 4))
```

## S-Figures 30 and 31

```{r}
#| label: setup-outlier-data

# Use the same individual and initial dataset across all sampling procedures.
outlier_predictions <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "parquet_v2")
) |>
  filter(
    dgm == "nonlinear",
    sample_size == 458,
    model == "glmnet",
    iter == 11,
    id == 56
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  left_join(
    original_predictions |>
      select(dgm, sample_size, model, iter, id, original_pred_p),
    by = c("dgm", "sample_size", "model", "iter", "id"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    method_label = factor(
      method,
      levels = names(method_labels),
      labels = unname(method_labels)
    )
  )

outlier_case <- outlier_predictions |>
  distinct(true_p, original_pred_p)
stopifnot(nrow(outlier_case) == 1L)

outlier_summary <- outlier_predictions |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min_prediction = min(pred_p),
    above_099 = sum(pred_p > 0.99),
    near_one = sum(pred_p > 1 - 1e-10),
    q025 = quantile(pred_p, 0.025),
    q975 = quantile(pred_p, 0.975),
    .by = method
  ) |>
  mutate(range_width = q975 - q025)
stopifnot(nrow(outlier_summary) == 7L, all(outlier_summary$n == 200L))

get_outlier_stat <- function(method_value, statistic) {
  value <- outlier_summary |>
    filter(method == method_value) |>
    pull(all_of(statistic))
  stopifnot(length(value) == 1L)
  value
}
```

**S-Figure 30. Figure 5 with the outlying observation included.**

```{r}
#| label: s-figure-30
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.8
#| cache: true

comparison_results |>
  filter(
    dgm == "nonlinear",
    metric %in% primary_metrics,
    sample_size_label == sample_size_labels[1]
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(true_p, rel_abs_difference, color = method_label, fill = method_label)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = grey(0.5), linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "gam",
    formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs")
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(metric_label),
    cols = vars(model_label),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme(panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "True (DGM) outcome probability",
    y = "Absolute relative deviation",
    color = "Procedure",
    fill = "Procedure"
  )
```
